known_failure_pattern: median pair-support fraction below the frozen v8 predictive envelope
mean pair-support Jaccard turnover inside the frozen v8 predictive envelope
interaction-Shannon relative context range above the frozen v8 predictive envelope

purpose: Post-falsification mechanism diagnosis only. Determine whether the remaining Cabrera mismatch is primarily associated with source-observed local plant/resource opportunity, observation exposure, or residual pair realization. This diagnosis cannot convert the failed v8 test into a pass and cannot tune v8 support strengths.

diagnostic_decomposition.global_pair_support_fraction: positive pairs in the context / 295 pooled positive opportunity pairs
diagnostic_decomposition.sampled_positive_plant_fraction: pooled-positive plant identities represented by any obs census row in the context / 22 pooled-positive plant identities
diagnostic_decomposition.plant_conditioned_pair_opportunity_fract: pooled opportunity pairs whose plant is represented by any obs census row in the context / 295 pooled opportunity pairs
diagnostic_decomposition.pair_realization_given_sampled_plants: positive context pairs / pooled opportunity pairs whose plant is represented by an obs census row in that context
diagnostic_decomposition.unique_census_count: number of unique censo values in the context
diagnostic_decomposition.total_unique_census_minutes: sum Delta_T_minutes once per unique COMMUNITY x visita x censo, only if duration is internally consistent within each census
diagnostic_decomposition.observed_flower_exposure: sum N observed flowers once per unique COMMUNITY x visita x censo x Plant sp, only if the value is internally consistent within each census-plant record
diagnostic_decomposition.interaction_shannon: Shannon entropy of positive context N ind pair weights
diagnostic_decomposition.positive_pair_count: number of positive canonical plant x pollinator pairs

robustness: Report Spearman rho descriptively and the leave-one-COMMUNITY-out rho range for every relationship. Do not use naive context-level p-values as confirmatory evidence because contexts are nested/repeated within communities and visits.

interpretation_rules.plant_opportunity_signal: Treat local plant/resource opportunity as a strong missing layer if global pair sparsity tracks sampled-positive-plant fraction or plant-conditioned pair opportunity strongly and conditioning on sampled plants materially raises the median pair-realization fraction.
interpretation_rules.observation_exposure_signal: Treat observation exposure as an important measurement layer if pair realization given sampled plants rises materially with census count, census minutes, or observed-flower exposure.
interpretation_rules.shannon_support_signal: Treat the Shannon-amplitude mismatch as mainly support-richness driven if Shannon tracks positive-pair count strongly while interaction-evenness is substantially less variable than Shannon.
interpretation_rules.residual_pair_signal: If pair realization remains very sparse after conditioning on sampled plants and has weak association with exposure, retain a residual ecological pair-support mechanism gap.

prohibited: change v8 support or weight strength values
rerun the Cabrera primary test with a selected better-fitting strength
use rpi to replace the failed obs primary test
change N ind to N visit flowers
call this post-failure diagnostic independent confirmation
use diagnostic associations to erase or relabel the v8 falsification
claim_boundary: This is a post-hoc decomposition of a preserved falsification. It can identify the next mechanism/observation layer to test prospectively, but it cannot validate a replacement model on Cabrera.
